channel.title: Daily MYRSS Digest
channel.description: World affairs and cultural reading; RSS-based unless noted. One older archive selection.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Dutch financial ties to companies supporting Israeli occupation
item.description: The newspaper reports that Dutch financial links to companies supporting the Israeli occupation remain substantial. RSS headline only.

item.title: de Volkskrant | Two more oil tankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The headline reports renewed tanker fires in the strategically important shipping lane; causes are not established by the headline. RSS headline only.

item.title: New York Times | Solomon Islands signs security treaty with Australia
item.description: The newspaper reports a security treaty with Australia, describing it as a setback for China. Archive headline only.

item.title: New York Times | Japan backs International Criminal Court despite US pressure
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged faster financial support for the court despite US opposition. RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Deutsche Bank allegedly waived anti-money-laundering checks for major clients
item.description: FTM alleges systematic circumvention of customer screening, including for a Russian oligarch under US sanctions. New investigation findings; RSS summary.

item.title: Follow the Money | Radboud advised to suspend Chinese university partnerships
item.description: An advisory committee recommends cutting ties with universities in China and Hong Kong. RSS summary; older archive selection, 19 November.

item.title: Reuters | EU reportedly considers €50 billion sovereign technology fund
item.description: The Financial Times reports a proposed fund to support longer-term investments in AI and quantum computing and reduce foreign dependence. Reuters could not independently verify the report; original Reuters report checked.

item.title: Reuters | US reportedly shelves Russian business incentives for Ukraine peace
item.description: The Financial Times reports Washington has dropped proposed commercial incentives after limited Russian interest. Reuters could not independently verify the report; original Reuters report checked.

item.title: The New Yorker | How Offline Should a Person Be?
item.description: An essay considers whether reducing internet use gradually is enough or more radical changes are needed. RSS summary.

item.title: The New Yorker | Facing Mortality at the Airport, in The End
item.description: An animated short by Niki Lindroth von Bahr imagines creatures at an airport approaching apocalypse. RSS summary.
